name: Newport Specialty Foods
old_description: Founded in 1982, Ace Endico is the largest fine foods purveyor and distributor in Westchester and Putnam Counties. Headquartered in Brewster, New York, Ace Endico delivers to restaurants, specialty shops, country clubs, and businesses throughout the Northeast.
about:
Newport Specialty Foods, based in Middletown, Rhode Island, functions as a specialty food distributor across the Northeast. The business, operating as Newport Specialty Group, has merged with Ace Endico, a purveyor founded in 1982 and based in Brewster, New York, which describes itself as the largest fine foods distributor in Westchester and Putnam counties. Deliveries reach restaurants, specialty shops, country clubs, and other businesses throughout the Northeast.

The combined operation supplies imported, domestic, and local products — fresh produce, dry goods, cut-to-order seafood, and specialty items — backed by a team of corporate chefs and food specialists who offer recipe development and menu consulting.

Clients include restaurants, caterers, hotels, schools, food manufacturers, breweries, and home cooks, along with specialty retailers and country clubs throughout the region.

The company states its focus on quality and an elevated experience beyond traditional distribution, citing chef-driven support and a curated assortment as key differentiators.
